'''2010 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Kevin Shannon DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Shannon]] at [[2010 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Shannon
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2

== Decklist ==

The sheet says the deck is the same as the player's [[2010 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Kevin Shannon DS Endor Operations|list from the day before]], with these changes: Short Range Combo -> Cold Feet V; Weapon Lev Combo -> Something Special V; Abyss V -> Code Clearance. The list below applies them.
